integrity: An analytic Markov generator proof and independent Poisson-survival integral are given; diagnostic code is not an infinite proof. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Model-specific stationary moment theorem: independent Poisson position-only, stochastic-volatility-only, and synchronized resets with known stochastic-volatility noise amplitude.
An inverse based on exact moments does not establish a statistically stable finite-sample inference procedure.
Does not classify the complete spatial density, temporal correlation functions, non-Poisson resetting, or correlated Brownian noises.
A related general diffusivity-ergodicity article was compared from its abstract only; priority beyond indexed accessible literature remains subject to independent assessment.
All stationary two-time second moments are identical across common-clock intensities with fixed marginal rates; no equivalence is asserted for higher-order temporal distributions.
title: Identifying common reset shocks from the stationary kurtosis of a diffusing-diffusivity tracer
